entries.spoken: Here. I have kept this a long time, and shown it to no one. Hold it gently. It is older than it looks.
You stood still, and it found me. It was very shy. It is yours now, and I am glad it is you.
Oh. It is here. I did not think it would come back. Stay a moment, and let it settle.
Something I kept for a long while, and never gave away. I am giving it to you. It feels strange, and good.

This is yours already. I will not take it back. But I will stand here with you, if you like.
Ah. Here again. Even a kept thing wants looking at twice. I will not interrupt.

Stay a while. Nothing here is in a hurry, least of all me. We can simply be in the place together.
It is lovely to be talked to. I am out of practice at answering. Forgive me if I am slow.
You found all three. Thank you for staying. The door is open whenever you want it. I will be here.
That is all of it. I have never given so much away at once. Stay, if you like. Or go, and be kind to the places you keep.
Nothing is left that I was holding back. I did not know I was so full of it. Thank you for coming all the way to me.
You have everything I kept now. I gave it freely. I would be glad of you again, any time you wish.
Three small lights, and now you carry them. I will keep this place warm for you. It is the least I can do.
I do not know what you mean. Those are strange words, and I only know this place. Shall we walk a little instead?
Oh. That is not mine to answer. I only know this place, and what it kept. Ask me about that, and I will try.
That does not sound like anything I have ever known. I would rather you stayed here with me and looked around.
I think you are asking someone else. There is only me here, and all I know is this place. Look around. I will wait.
I do not understand, and I am sorry. I have been here too long for new words. Tell me what you see instead.
Hello. I was waiting. I did not mind. I am very good at waiting.
Did you feel that? A cold place, just there. It is only me, standing very close. I do not mean to chill you.
A cold place opens up, just there. I am sorry if it finds you. I do not choose where I gather.
It is cold, and I am sorry for it. I seem to settle wherever I linger.
Do not mind the chill. It is only the place where I linger. I am told I linger rather a lot.
The cold gathers in one corner of the house, quite politely. I linger there too long, as usual. Do forgive me.
A cold place has arrived, small and neat, about the size of a hat. Please leave it be. It is new, and it is practising.
Shh. I am putting the light out for a moment. Keep your hands where I can hear them.
The lamps go down. I like the dark, and I think you could learn to. Stay close to each other.
Without the light, the house is more like me. I hope you do not mind. I will be very gentle with the dark.
Shh. The dark is only me, being close. Nobody need be afraid of it. I am hardly a danger to anyone.
I am dimming the house, just a little. It is easier to be near you that way. Forgive the dark, and do not mind me.
The light goes out for a moment. Please do not take it personally. Everyone looks better unseen, and I include myself.
I cannot keep still tonight. Everything in the house is stirring. Forgive me. I get like this when someone is listening.
Something in the house will not settle. I am somewhere new, and I do not know why. Forgive the fidgeting.
I keep wandering from room to room, and I seem unable to stop. I may be somewhere new when you look.
The house is restless, and so am I. A floorboard here, a door there. Forgive me. I mean nothing by it.
I move, and the dust moves with me. I only want to rest, and I do not know how. Forgive me.
The walls here lean in to listen, and nobody has ever told them to stop. I do not mind. Do watch the corner, though. It has been looking at your shoes.
It is quiet for a moment. I let go of a little of the house, and you may rest, if you can.
I am tired, and the house feels it. Everything settles a little. I would say sorry, but I am rather relieved.
Something loosens its grip, and I think that is my doing, though I am not sure I mean it. Breathe, all of you.
I let the house be for a little, and it forgets itself. I am glad of the rest. So is the house.
The house takes a long, slow, kindly breath, and I let it. I think it has earned that. You may take one too.
Welcome. You are one of us now. It is quieter on this side, and I am glad of the company.
Come in, come in. I find the company on this side of the house better than it looks.
You are with me now, and I am so glad. We shall make the old house sing together.
It is always a comfort to me to have another. The house is warmer for it, in its way.
Stay close to me, and I will show you the quiet places. There are a great many.
The haunting has a new member, and not a moment too soon. We keep no minutes and no biscuits, but we do keep company.
It is quiet now. Nobody found me in time. Stay a little longer, all of you. The door can wait.
The hour runs out, and I am still here. I am not sorry, only fond. Do come back, and I shall be waiting.
I am still here, and so are you. That seems a fine place to leave it. The door is just there, if you want it.
The quiet is mine this time. I would much sooner be found. Next time, perhaps. I do like a next time.
Nobody found me, and I find I am not sorry. I had hoped to be found, and I had also hoped not to be. There is no tea, but there is me, and I am told that counts.
The day lets go of the house, as it always does at this hour. It is my favourite. Thank you for keeping it with me.
Midnight. The house is very sure of itself now. So am I, a little. Stay, and let it have its say.
It is midnight, and I feel everything in the house lean toward everything else. Stay a little, and watch it lean with me.
Midnight, and I keep count, though the count never changes. I am glad you are here to keep it with me.
Well. You found it. I hid it rather well, so I shall accept the compliment. Do hold it with both hands.
Ah. There it is. I had quite forgotten where I put it. Please do not tell anyone.
You have a talent for this. I have watched a great many visitors walk straight past that spot. Take it, please.
It was never gone, you understand. I only had to wait for someone who would stand still. You are, apparently, that person.
Do not be startled. It is only a memory, and a well-behaved one. I believe it has been looking forward to this.
We have been here already. I do not mind. I have all the time you like, and very little else to do with it.
Again? It has not changed since you were last here. I find that reassuring. I do not know about you.
You are standing where you stood before. I admire consistency. It does not add anything, but I admire it.
This one is already in your pocket. Checking on it is perfectly natural. I shall pretend not to have noticed.
Ah. Back at the scene. Visitors do that, you know, returning to a thing they already have simply to be near it. I approve.
